arStrings.szText: Defeat the Lesser Evils to acquire their {c_highlight}Corrupted Essences.{/c} Return them to Hadriel in the Heavenly Forge to unlock {c_highlight}Divine Gifts. {/c}
The Lesser Evils have invaded Sanctuary. Duriel dominates Helltide. Belial rules The Pit. Andariel commands the Kurast Undercity. Azmodan can be found in the world boss arena in Hawezar.
{c_highlight}Divine Gifts{/c} can be leveled by acquiring Divine Favor. Favor is earned by slaying the Lesser Evils as well as the monsters infected by the Lesser Evils' malice.

Hadriel will {c_highlight}Sanctify{/c} your items if you are deemed worthy. In pre-Torment difficulties, slay Lesser Evils to earn the privilege of the Heavenly Forge. In post-Torment, collect {c_highlight}Heavenly Sigils{/c} to Sanctify whenever you like.
Your progression earned through Season Ranks apply to both the softcore and hardcore seasonal realms.
As you progress through Season Ranks, be sure to periodically check in the Season tab for new rewards.
Uncertain on what to do next? Check the Season tab for a suite of bonus objectives to pursue on your journeys through Sanctuary.
Completing {c_highlight}Capstone Dungeons{/c} grants significant rewards, such as powerful gear, skill points, paragon points, cosmetics, and more.
Capstone dungeons are a fixed difficulty level. Having trouble defeating them? Level up and return. Monsters will not level with you.
Progress through {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c} to unlock new rewards. Complete {c_highlight}Capstone Dungeons{/c} to unlock new tiers of Season Ranks.
{c_highlight}Sanctification{/c} blesses equipment with powerful effects but in the process becomes {c_highlight}Unmodifiable,{/c} preventing any future modifications to the equipment from any source.
